$comment: Glossary for L-13 (doc 06 §3.7, §4.3; doc 08 §7.2; R64). Sources: doc 08 §7.2.1 tables T-A–T-E (tr column), checked key by key against WordByWordPrototype/Localizable.xcstrings (tr values, 2026-10-06); §7.2.2 rules ①–③ (no X-fix lists tr); §7.3 tr row (siz; 'sağa kaydırın', 'çift dokunun'); the tr copy deck (src/locales/tr.json, M3, T3).

required: key path → value used verbatim (rule ①). Kickers use the app's names; the lookup kicker drops the '(AI Anlamı)' suffix like en / ja / es / fr do; tr has no short name for the swipe feature (T-A '—'), so the kicker is the feature name 'Çevirmek için Kaydırın' (daily_sentence_translation_limit). Quota-table rows are the app's names: daily_sentence_translation_limit + the engine ('bulut motoru' / 'yerel motor', after swipe_translation_engine_mode_*: 'Bulut çeviri motoru' / 'Yerel motor'), word_meaning_lookup_title, more_definitions_title, ai_pronunciation_word / _sentence, audio_playback_title_local, Chunk Extraction, sentence_skeleton_settings_navigation_title; the syntax row is the noun form of get_syntax_explanation_button. Quoted app names keep the app's own spelling ('Yapay Zeka', 'AI Anlamı'); sentences write the standard form 'yapay zekâ' (doc 03 §2.3 tr keywords).

contains: in-app button / setting names that the sentences quote verbatim in “ ” (rule ①; T-B get_syntax_explanation_button, view_title_swipe_history; T-C audio_playback_title_*; T-E upgrade_now_button / restore_purchase_button). Action Flow keeps the App Store name (doc 08 D3, §7.2.3) and quotes the app's 'Cümle eylem akışı' once.

banned: variants that must not appear in any leaf value (pattern = literal text unless regex:true; flags 'i' = case-insensitive). Regexes use \p{L} look-arounds instead of \b because \b is ASCII-only and Turkish words end in ç ğ ı ö ş ü.
